settings.q: Can you recreate a specific game or anime weapon?
settings.a: Yes - send us reference images or a design and we'll model and build it. Original concepts are welcome too.

settings.q: Is it safe to carry at events?
settings.a: We build props to be lightweight and convention-friendly, you should still avoid swinging it and hitting of hard surface since this sword is for decorative purpose mainly.

settings.hero_desc: Blade of Aatrox is a large fantasy sword from League of Legends with built-in glowing LED edges, sculpted in an intricate jagged design and finished for display or cosplay. Sword is 1.6 meters in length and features heartbeat LED animation which make it look alive instead of a static cosplay prop.
settings.perso_placeholder: Engrave your name on the sword
settings.s1_body: Blade of Aatrox fantasy sword is built for impact - a detailed, sculpted blade with glowing LED channels that light up the edges and runes. If you are a collector of swords, fan of Leagues of legends or serious cosplayer, This unique sword adds to your collection . A showpiece for cosplayers, collectors, launch events and themed displays.
settings.case_heading: A Sword That Steals the Comicon
settings.case_body: We commission this for a cosplayer who was participating in Comicon. Built as an prop, this sword was designed to read from across a room and glow on cue - the kind of statement piece that anchors a cosplay, a launch stand or a themed display.
settings.case_quote: The glow is unreal - it stole the show at the event.
settings.prov_p: Its a soul trapping weapon of Aatrox from Leagues of Legend. Weapon serves as eternal prison for Aatrox consciousness. Grands him power to possess and consume anyone foolish enough to wield it. A great prop blurs the line between the screen and the room. Sculpted in detail and lit from within, this sword brings a fictional weapon convincingly into the real world.
